first_step_test: One rounded sloping sharpener shell fixes the whole object and leaves clear space above its left corner for a single curled shaving.

source.notes: Contact-sheet-first marker raster; preserve any rejected iterations privately.

final_elements.name: sharpener shell
final_elements.description: One stout rounded wedge with a broad front face and sloping upper edge.

final_elements.name: blade plate
final_elements.description: One narrow diagonal inset blade plate on the front face.

final_elements.name: blade screw
final_elements.description: One round screw centered in the inset blade plate.

final_elements.name: pencil opening
final_elements.description: One small dark oval hole on the right end of the shell.

final_elements.name: single curled shaving
final_elements.description: One tan ribbon shaving rising from the left upper shell edge and curling outward once.

final_elements.name: two short hatch marks
final_elements.description: Exactly two short black hatches on the lower front face.

final_elements.name: broken ground shadow
final_elements.description: A short broken dark shadow just under the shell.

frames.visible_job: Draw one squat rounded shell with a sloping top and broad front face.
frames.instruction: With a black felt tip, draw the left rounded end, let the top rise slightly toward the right, and close a broad wedge-shaped front face with a flatter base. Leave clear paper above the left corner for the shaving.

frames.visible_job: Add one diagonal blade plate inside the shell face.
frames.instruction: Inside the broad front face, pull two short parallel slanted lines and join their ends into a narrow blade plate. Keep a strip of shell visible all around it.

frames.visible_job: Add one circular screw on the plate and one oval pencil opening at the right end.
frames.instruction: Place one small round screw inside the blade plate. At the right end of the shell, draw one dark oval pencil opening without crossing the established outer contour.

frames.visible_job: Attach one loose ribbon shaving at the left upper edge and curl it outward once.
frames.instruction: From the open left upper edge, sweep a broad ribbon upward and left into one loose curl; return a second line beside it to show its width. Keep this single shaving away from the screw and pencil opening.

frames.visible_job: Add exactly two lower-face hatches and a short broken shadow under the shell.
frames.instruction: Draw two short hatches near the lower front edge, then set three separated ground strokes just beneath the base. Let the black marker dry before filling the shell.

final_step.visible_job: Fill established shell, blade, screw and shaving regions with streaky marker color only.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established shell bright red, the blade plate cool gray, the screw pale yellow, and the single shaving warm tan. Pull marker strokes along the shaving curve, leave a few paper streaks, and reinforce only the existing black edges and shadow.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square crop shows only one thick black rounded wedge shell with an open broad front face and blank space above its low left corner.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Six padded square crops preserve the same sloping shell, inset blade, single slotted screw, right oval, one curled shaving, two lower hatches and three-stroke ground shadow before bright marker fill. No temporary guides are used or removed.

transitions.observed_addition: The single wedge shell remains in its fixed position while one long slanted blade plate appears inside its front face.
transitions.instruction_match: The corrected first instruction establishes the rising top slope visible in both crops; the second adds only the blade plate within that shell.

transitions.observed_addition: The shell and inset plate persist; one round slotted screw appears on the plate and one dark oval pencil opening appears on the right end.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction covers the new centered screw and dark right-end oval.

transitions.observed_addition: The shell, plate, round screw and right oval remain; one broad ribbon shaving rises from the left upper edge and curls outward once.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction matches the single wide ribbon shaving and its left upper attachment.

transitions.observed_addition: The same single curl, screw and right oval remain; exactly two small diagonal hatches appear on the lower face and three separate shadow strokes appear under the base.
transitions.instruction_match: The fifth instruction names the two face hatches and three separated strokes visible beneath the shell.

transitions.observed_addition: The shell, blade plate, one slotted screw, right oval, single curl, two hatches and three-stroke shadow persist; red, gray, yellow and tan fill only their established regions.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction fills established shapes with marker strokes and reinforces their edges without adding new contours.
